text.offer: Jonas D'Accor says, "Every lord in Meridian keeps knights to remind us who's in charge. Unhorse ten of them. Then go to Qerti'nya and swear Kraanan's oath: free men, fighting for free men."
text.progress: The knights ride the old roads. Priestess Qerti'nya keeps the Temple of Kraanan.
text.complete: Priestess Qerti'nya takes your oath. "Jonas will call you Captain now. When you have risen to the rank, ask him for Kraanan's own gift: say champion."
